hooks.name: Post Git Commit Secrets Check
hooks.description: Verify no secrets were committed in latest git commit

action.command: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const vaultPath = path.dirname(process.cwd()); const gitLog = fs.readFileSync('.git/logs/HEAD', 'utf8'); const latestCommit = gitLog.split('\n').filter(l => l.includes('commit ')).pop(); const latestCommitId = latestCommit ? latestCommit.split(' ')[1] : null; if (!latestCommitId) { console.log('No commits yet'); process.exit(0); } const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const status = execSync('git status --porcelain', { cwd: vaultPath, encoding: 'utf8' }); const untracked = status.split('\n').filter(l => l.startsWith('??')).map(l => l.substring(2)).filter(f => f.includes('.env') || f.includes('.secrets') || f.includes('_secret') || f.includes('_private')); if (untracked.length > 0) { console.error('WARNING: Potential secrets in untracked files: ' + untracked.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('✅ No secrets detected in latest commit'); } catch (err) { console.log('Could not verify commit'); }"
